services.name: Gone Fishing
services.desc: Relax in this newly remodeled hotel room at Laguna Reef in Rockport, Texas. This charming space features two queen beds and comfortably accommodates 2 to 4 guests. While the room faces the parking area, you'll have full access to exceptional waterfront amenities, including a resort pool and hot tub with stunning views of Aransas Bay. Enjoy fishing from the private 1,000-foot pier, or explore the community beach area perfect for wading and crabbing.
